summary.headline: Comet Omens and Political Upheaval
summary.text: Judgments on shooting stars, meteors, pillars, trumpets, Persian comets, and spears, including their indications for winds, drought, war, disease, kings, dynastic succession, and regional upheaval. Allamah Tusi and Abu Ma'shar are cited, with a historical example of a spear comet seen at Qazvin in Libra in 1027 AH and its predicted effects on Transoxiana and the Arab provinces.
